commands.notes: Listening TCP sockets and bound, unconnected UDP sockets from the kernel socket tables. Rows print COMMAND PID USER TYPE NAME (-t prints PIDs only; -n and -P are accepted, output is always numeric). This session's listeners are always listed and carry their job identity. For a named port, listeners held outside the session are listed after the host process inspection approval process_list uses; without it, stderr says those holders were not inspected. A holder the host cannot read shows its port with PID unknown. Read-only: kill and pkill still refuse processes this session did not start.

reuse.extension: Reuse the hostprocess port-holder owner behind process_list over the lineage kernel socket tables; no lsof binary, no host-global signal authority.
reuse.evidence_kind: existing operation and adjacent regression references; not new-command qualification
